risk_register_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 3A - Open Risks, Methodological Limitations & Blockers

active_blockers.name: Activation Authority Is Blocked
active_blockers.description: DEC-06 is strictly BLOCKED. No cryptographic activation token exists. The trading engine cannot poll market data, execute orders, or connect to brokers.
active_blockers.resolution: Requires explicit, independent human repository owner decision after resolving DEC-01 through DEC-05.

active_blockers.name: Market Data Provider & Contractual License Unselected
active_blockers.description: No active provider subscription or API key is configured. DEC-01 and DEC-02 are PENDING.
active_blockers.resolution: Owner must register provider account and sign non-professional agreement.

methodological_and_scientific_risks.name: Historical Data Snooping and In-Sample Selection Bias
methodological_and_scientific_risks.description: 43+ candidate strategies were tested on historical Tier 1/2 data. D2's historical performance (21.20% MaxDD) cannot be interpreted as out-of-sample evidence.
methodological_and_scientific_risks.mitigation: Prospective forward evaluation resets selection bias if and only if parameters and endpoints are preregistered irrevocably.

methodological_and_scientific_risks.name: Low-Volatility Horizon Risk (Underpowered Sample)
methodological_and_scientific_risks.description: If prospective market conditions feature a relentless, low-volatility bull run, 252 calendar days may produce fewer than 30 defensive sessions, leaving the evaluation severely underpowered.
methodological_and_scientific_risks.mitigation: Contingent extension protocol allowing evaluation to extend up to 504 sessions.

methodological_and_scientific_risks.name: Mechanical Cash Drag in Strong Bull Markets
methodological_and_scientific_risks.description: D2 holds 50% defensive cash during risk-off triggers. In false-alarm whipsaw regimes, D2 will lag E0 significantly. If lag exceeds 200 bps, D2 fails the secondary constraint.
methodological_and_scientific_risks.mitigation: Preregistered 200 bps tolerance formally bounds acceptable insurance cost.

methodological_and_scientific_risks.name: Leveraged ETF Volatility Decay (Beta Slippage)
methodological_and_scientific_risks.description: Guardian Alpha trades 3x leveraged ETFs (TQQQ, SOXL, UPRO). High-volatility sideways chop causes severe compounding value erosion independent of index levels.
methodological_and_scientific_risks.mitigation: D2's cash cushion partially mitigates this by halving exposure, but underlying asset decay remains a structural risk.

methodological_and_scientific_risks.name: Simulator Parity and Host Execution Gap
methodological_and_scientific_risks.description: Backtest assumes perfect fill at bar close without slippage or market impact. In live paper trading, order routing delays and wide spreads during volatility spikes may cause execution slippage.
methodological_and_scientific_risks.mitigation: Stage 2H-B sell-first execution ordering resolves cash settlement timing, but real market slippage must be measured prospectively.
